name: Product Finder
description: Project Finder is a web application that was done as a group project. It provides users a way to search for a better price online of an item by uploading a photo of the product. The application was built using React and also uses Google's Vision API to find similar images and Real Time Product Search API to get product information.

name: Restaurant Tracker
description: Restaurant Tracker is an application that lets users explore restaurants in London with interactive maps and search features. Users can search by name or type of cuisine. My contributions: Added interactive markers on the Mapbox map to show restaurant locations, implemented cuisine-based search to filter restaurants by type, built a search form to allow users to find restaurants by name or keyword, and integrated the Local Business Data API to fetch up-to-date restaurant information.

name: Product Feedback App
description: This is a full stack application where users can give suggestions or feedback on a product, comment on other users' suggestions, and reply to comments. Users can also upvote a suggestion. The application uses Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Cloudinary API.
